dedupe_keys.name: modelica powersystems library steady state and transient models of ac dc and variable frequency power systems

description: PowerSystems is an open Modelica library for modelling electrical power systems at different levels of detail, from power flow to fast electromagnetic transients. It is maintained in the modelica-3rdparty collection, originally by Rüdiger Franke and Hansjürg Wiesmann, and absorbed the detailed one-phase and three-phase component models of the earlier SPOT library; part of the work was funded by the ITEA2 MODRIO and EUROSYSLIB projects. Coverage: generic component library, not tied to any network. Generic components adapt through a replaceable phase system to AC systems (DC power flow, steady state, transient and unbalanced), variable-frequency systems such as wind turbine drives, and DC systems such as HVDC, with generators, machines, lines, transformers, inverters, semiconductors, controls and example systems. Format and access: Modelica source on GitHub, with release v2.0.0 (May 2024) built on the Modelica Standard Library 4.0; runs in OpenModelica or commercial Modelica tools; free. Licence: Modelica License 2.0. Caveats: users build their own networks from components, there are no ready national grid models, and results depend on the chosen phase system and solver. Simulation uses: dynamic studies of faults, converter control and microgrids for resilience and cascading failure analysis, and as a physical model inside energy system digital twins. Related records: OpenModelica (platform-openmodelica) runs the library, and OpenIPSL (model-openipsl) is the phasor-domain Modelica library for large grid stability studies.
